description: A creator's recent posts, fetched so their opening lines can be read as a set. Extract the repeatable formula yourself: the devices they reuse, written as fill-in-the-blank templates someone could apply to another topic, each one saying how many posts it is drawn from — a template that fits one post is not a pattern. Costs 2 nooticr credits, for the one get_user_posts call it makes. Use to reverse-engineer a creator you want to learn from.
